agreement.note: Agreement is between two LLM judges. It is not human correctness.

dev_test_rule: Inside each company stratum, the first round(n * 0.6) slots are test and the rest are dev. A stratum of one slot is test. A stratum of two is one test and one dev, so the global dev share is above 0.4. Realized counts are stored on the sampling manifest. Do not rebalance after seeing retrieval results.
limitations: model-family correlation between the generator and judge A
judge agreement is not evidence of human correctness
test_holdout: The test split is for a later frozen comparison. Do not tune a retriever by repeatedly inspecting this test split.
